event: 2025 ILCA 4 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: Hearing No. 59 was heard together with hearing No. 60 in accordance with RRS 63.(2)(b) since both hearings arose from the same incident.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: The protest time limit on 23.06.2025 for ILCA 4 Men gold fleet was at 17:50.
CRO 221179 delivered the request for redress at 18:54.
ITA 213024 delivered the request for redress at 18:55.
Both ITA 213024 and CRO 221179 stated that there was no device avaliable with access to the online system.
conclusions: There was no good reason for the International Jury to extend the time limit.
decision: The request for redress is invalid.
